leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue component that fetches and renders data on the server using server-side rendering (SSR)
Configure a Vue application to generate static HTML pages at build time using static site generation (SSG)
Construct a Vue component that conditionally renders content based on whether it's executing on the server or client
Integrate server-side data fetching with client-side interactivity in a Vue component
Manipulate Vue's rendering modes to optimize performance for different types of content
Initialize a Vue project with both SSR and SSG capabilities using appropriate build configurations
Apply hydration techniques to attach Vue's reactivity to server-rendered HTML
lessonTitle: React Server Components & SSR vs SSG
